product_metadata.title: Stainless Steel Utensil Holder for Kitchen Counter - Perforated Kitchen Utensil Holder for Countertop Chopstick Spoon Spatula Holder Dryer Rack with Hooks - Utensil Caddy for Cooking Utensils Holder
features: High Quality Large Utensil Holder: The utensil caddy for countertop is made of stainless steel, which is sturdy, rustproof, and dishwasher safe. This kitchen spatula holder is well crafted, lightweight has no rough or sharp edges, this cooling utensil holder is durable for long-term use.

Portable Size of Kitchen Tool Holder: The large utensil holder for countertop with a height of 3.9 inches and length of one cube side 2.5 inches is conducive to drying and keeping the kitchen clean and tidy. Our cup utensil holder also save space in the kitchen.

Easy To Attach: This perforated large utensil holder for kitchen counter is a hanging tableware dryer that fastens easy to your dish rack with hooks on the backside. The hooks on the back of this silverware holder for kitchen utensils match most dish racks.

Perforated Water Drainage: The kitchen utensils holder with perforated holes on the side and bottom to effective water drain. With this hollow and ventilated design of this countertop utensil holder, the spoons chopstick and other cooking utensils caddy can dry faster.

Perfect Cutlery Stand: Use this extra large utensil holder to organize small kitchen utensils such as chopsticks, straws, teaspoons, spoons, spatulas, fruit forks, tongs, whisks, and other kitchen utensils. You can use this removable utensil holder in dishwasher to wash small items
